purpose: 沿官方真实链接取得连续原XLSX和栏目，先核字段/版本及历史存档路由，不输入模型
executed_source:
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
from concurrent.futures import ThreadPoolExecutor,as_completed
import requests,json,hashlib,re
from urllib.parse import urljoin,urlparse
from bs4 import BeautifulSoup
ROOT=Path.cwd()
OUT=ROOT/'reports/research/510300_safe_client_fx_cause_source_qualification_v1'
entry=json.loads((OUT/'官方入口原响应.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
targets=[]
for row in entry['target_actual_links']:
 if row['label']=='银行结售汇数据时间序列':
  targets.append({'id':'D01','url':row['url'],'label':row['label'],'route_type':'CURRENT_CONTINUOUS_XLSX_NOT_HISTORICAL_RELEASE_ADMISSION'})
 if row['label']=='银行结售汇':
  targets.append({'id':'S02','url':row['url'],'label':row['label'],'route_type':'ACTUAL_OFFICIAL_CATEGORY_NAVIGATION'})
assert len(targets)==2
def sha(blob):return hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
def save(path,value):
 if path.exists():raise RuntimeError('拒绝覆盖原件回执')
 path.write_text(json.dumps(value,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
save(OUT/'连续原表与栏目请求清单.json',{'registered_before_request':True,'attempts_each':1,'targets':targets})
def fetch(item):
 record={**item,'requested_at':datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat(),'attempts':1}
 try:
  with requests.Session() as session:
   response=session.get(item['url'],timeout=(10,25),stream=True,headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 historical research'})
   blob=bytearray()
   for part in response.iter_content(65536):
    blob.extend(part)
    if len(blob)>20971520:raise RuntimeError('原对象超冻结单件上限')
   blob=bytes(blob)
   extension='.xlsx' if item['id']=='D01' else '.html'
   path=OUT/'sources'/('官方原件_'+item['id']+extension)
   assert not path.exists();path.write_bytes(blob)
   record.update({'status_code':response.status_code,'final_url':response.url,'response_headers':dict(response.headers),
    'bytes':len(blob),'sha256':sha(blob),'raw_path':path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()})
   if extension=='.html':
    soup=BeautifulSoup(blob.decode('utf-8',errors='replace'),'lxml')
    for tag in soup(['script','style','noscript']):tag.decompose()
    text=soup.get_text(' ',strip=True)
    (OUT/'sources'/('官方文本_'+item['id']+'.txt')).write_text(text+'\n',encoding='utf-8')
    links=[]
    for a in soup.find_all('a',href=True):
     label=a.get_text(' ',strip=True);url=urljoin(response.url,a['href'])
     if '结售汇' in label and urlparse(url).hostname=='www.safe.gov.cn':
      links.append({'label':label,'url':url})
    record['target_actual_links']=links
    record['title']=soup.title.get_text(' ',strip=True) if soup.title else None
 except Exception as error:record['request_error']=str(error)
 record['completed_at']=datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
 return record
records=[]
with ThreadPoolExecutor(max_workers=2) as pool:
 for future in as_completed([pool.submit(fetch,item) for item in targets]):
  row=future.result();records.append(row)
  print(json.dumps({k:row[k] for k in row if k in ['id','status_code','bytes','request_error','title','target_actual_links']},ensure_ascii=False))
save(OUT/'连续原表与栏目原响应索引.json',{'new_requests':2,'records':sorted(records,key=lambda x:x['id'])})
print('本阶段完成；累计三个直接原请求，不接纳当前长表为历史首版。')
